mapper.sql: a.id, a.version, a.feature_key, a.app_id, b.name AS app_name, b.cloud_id, c.name AS cloud_name, a.default_name, a.custom_name, COALESCE(a.custom_name, a.default_name) AS name, a.default_seq, a.custom_seq, COALESCE(a.custom_seq, a.default_seq) AS seq, a.description, a.visible, a.source
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM t_sys_feature a INNER JOIN t_sys_app b ON b.id = a.app_id INNER JOIN t_sys_cloud c ON c.id = b.cloud_id
a.app_id = #{form.appId} b.cloud_id = #{form.cloudId}
AND (a.feature_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{form.keyword}, '%') OR a.default_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{form.keyword}, '%') OR a.custom_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{form.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY ${listQuery.sortColumn} ${listQuery.sortOrder}, a.id ORDER BY c.seq, b.seq, COALESCE(a.custom_seq, a.default_seq), a.id
SELECT FROM t_sys_feature a INNER JOIN t_sys_app b ON b.id = a.app_id INNER JOIN t_sys_cloud c ON c.id = b.cloud_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
